entities.name: @okie/architecture
entities.responsibility: Canonical renderer-independent architecture model: extraction schema, snapshot validation, C4 projection, completeness scoring, and orthogonal routing.

entities.name: src/authoring.ts
entities.responsibility: Command/document model for hand-authored architecture edits before they become a snapshot.

entities.name: src/c4-completeness.ts
entities.responsibility: Scores how completely a snapshot and view cover the C4 bands.

entities.name: src/c4.ts
entities.responsibility: Projects a snapshot into C4 bands, layouts, and scoped views.

entities.name: src/extraction.ts
entities.responsibility: ArchitectureExtraction intake schema, limits, and validateArchitectureExtraction — the enrichment gate.

entities.name: src/model.ts
entities.responsibility: Canonical entity/relation/snapshot types and schema version for the architecture model.

entities.name: src/normalized.ts
entities.responsibility: Selectors over a validated snapshot, view, and story used by compilers.

entities.name: src/orthogonal-router.ts
entities.responsibility: Orthogonal edge routing around node obstacles for C4 diagrams.

entities.name: src/validation.ts
entities.responsibility: Validates snapshots, views, and stories against the frozen architecture contracts.

entities.name: validateArchitectureExtraction
entities.responsibility: Validates an ArchitectureExtraction document against schema, id, and list limits before the enrichment merge.
